messages.text: pretty rad I want to build a proceduarl quilt that is limitless you start zoomed in with max recursion and as you zoom out the initial square is circled by 8 more squares but of differnet shaes and clors that are set in the parameryters page and that 9 block becomes a 1 block as you zoom out because that 9 blick is surrounded by a 8 block the zooom level cant be completely infininite but tiling stragies will allow an impressive zoomout experience until the the entire screen is filled with micro siperksky squares - a tapestry if you will

Delivering R2 "Quilt" — a procedural, infinitely zoomable Sierpinski tapestry. Architecture: discrete level-stack with hierarchical 3×3 grids. Level 0 renders the recursive carpet; zooming out captures the canvas as a texture for the next level’s center tile, revealing 8 configurable neighbor patches (solid, stripes, checker, etc.), allowing seamless rebasing until the screen fills with micro-squares (tapestry mode). Includes 8 neighbor type/color editors and continuous pinch/pan controls.
